character: fat mossy-green kakapo, whiskered owl face, tiny useless wings, blissful half-closed eyes, fills two thirds of frame
props: a cracked piggy bank - over his head at the start, hugged after - spilling coins in every window; chicks in teller caps, their place is his belly and back until 7.35, never the ground; a lidless tin cash box
prop_continuity: the piggy bank is never let go and loses coins in every window; the cash box tips further over each time it appears
motion_rule: every window he covers ground - waddling hard at the lens, tumbling over or spinning round, never perched still to speak; the chicks scramble over him and snatch coins, he shoves them off; new shot size every window
environment: mossy forest floor running at the lens, bright shafts of noon sun; background under a third

audio.delivery: warm daft preacher voice, utterly certain, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: ko-PI, po-TOM, po-te-RYAT, E-to, NASH, PUT, GLAV-no-ye, us-PE-li, pe-red kon-TSOM
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; not a word before 0.7, none after 7.35
audio.lip_sync: beak moves on every syllable, beak clear of props while speaking
audio.sfx: pottery scraping, coins raining, scrabbling claws, tin box clatter

timeline.a: the piggy bank fills the whole frame, then sprouts two scaly feet and bolts at the lens
timeline.c: extreme close on the bank, pushing in

timeline.a: he tears the bank off his head and drives at the lens, coins spraying from the hole
timeline.c: big low, wings tearing it free

timeline.a: waddles hard at the lens hugging the bank, coins bouncing off the ground
rears up and shakes the bank overhead, a coin rain falling on the chicks
runs full tilt across the frame, chicks scrambling up his back after the coins
trips over the tin box and tumbles head over tail, coins fountaining at the lens
rolls upright still hugging the bank and drives at the lens
stamps both feet down, the whole coin pile jumping
spins a full turn, wings out, chicks flying off him sideways
charges back the other way, the cracked bank shedding a coin trail
shoves two chicks off his belly and barges on through the coins
runs straight into the lens until his face fills it, the bank splitting open
the piggy bank bursts and the whole hoard fountains up at the lens
every chick dives into the falling coins, the tin box clattering over them
he waddles past the lens hugging one last coin, empty shards trailing

must_appear: the bank running on its own legs at 0.0; his face torn free at 0.35; coins spilling in every window; the tumble over the box at 2.6; the full spin at 4.4; the bank bursting at 7.35
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, garbled or misspelled words, static camera, same shot size twice, he perches still while speaking, his beak hidden, his face visible before 0.35, a chick on the ground before 7.35, a window where the chicks do nothing, him small in frame, flying, extra wings, deformed anatomy, English speech, any word before 0.7 or after 7.35
